products.name: Nila Heritage Bangles
products.description: A richly detailed pair of gold-tone bangles with ruby- and emerald-coloured accents. Wear them together for a little festive magic, or one at a time for your own everyday ritual.

products.name: Lakshmi Temple Necklace
products.description: A heritage-inspired silhouette with little coin motifs, a sculptural Lakshmi pendant and soft pearl-style drops. Pair it with your favourite silk saree, or let it make a simple neckline feel extraordinary.

products.name: Malar Temple Jhumkas
products.description: An ode to the jhumkas you grew up admiring. Intricate gold-tone florals, ruby-coloured accents and a delicate pearl-style fringe bring a little ceremony to your everyday.
